cta.title: Clean your air
cta.desc: Take absolute control of your indoor environment. Precise, real-time tracking for CO2, particulate matter, temperature, and humidity.

index.sensory_desc: Advanced spectral analysis providing real-time visibility into your surrounding air quality with laboratory-grade precision.
index.cai_desc: Holistic calculation of overall air quality.
index.invisible_desc: Engineered to blend effortlessly into modern spaces, Clair features a minimalist industrial design with sharp angles and an absence of distracting screens, providing continuous environmental monitoring without compromising your interior aesthetic.
index.office_alt: Office environment with Clair Alpha Sensor

about.vision_desc: Clair was built from a desire to make invisible environmental data visible, actionable, and completely integrated into modern life.
about.team_desc: A multidisciplinary group of developers and designers bridging the gap between robust IoT engineering and pure, minimalist design.

product.aiq_desc: Clair Alpha continuously maps the invisible elements of your environment, it synthesizes a comprehensive Air Quality Index.
product.core_desc: Powered by an advanced ESP32 architecture. This serves as the central intelligence hub, instantly processing multi-sensor data and ensuring seamless Wi-Fi transmission to your network.
product.atm_desc: Equipped with an SCD41 module for simultaneous, laboratory-grade monitoring. It tracks CO2 saturation, ambient temperature, and relative humidity with absolute precision.
product.laser_desc: Utilizes a high-precision PMS5003 laser sensor to continuously measure ultra-fine particulate matter, actively tracking both PM2.5 and PM10 pollutants down to the sub-micron level.
product.oled_desc: Features a minimalist high-contrast OLED display. Designed for zero distraction, it provides immediate, app-free visibility of critical metrics without compromising the device's sharp, pure silhouette.

pricing.subs_desc: Advanced spectral analysis providing real-time visibility into your surrounding air quality with laboratory-grade precision.
pricing.free_desc: Included with your first Clair Alpha.
pricing.free_feat2: Real-time CO2 and particulate matter tracking
pricing.scale_desc: Whether you are securing a single private office or mapping the air quality of an entire architectural floorplan, the Clair platform adapts to your scale. Start with one, expand when ready.
pricing.scale_img_alt: Office environment with Clair Alpha Sensor

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: We're here to answer all your questions about Clair and help you improve air quality in your space.
contact.sales_desc: Interested in getting a Clair Alpha? Our sales team is available to help you with product information, pricing, and delivery options.
contact.support_desc: Having technical issues or questions about how to use your Clair? Our support team is ready to help you resolve any inconvenience.
contact.help_text: Documentation, FAQs and user guides available 24/7
contact.hq_desc: Visit us at our offices in San Isidro, where our team is ready to help you.

privacy.title: Legal & Privacy
privacy.lead: This page summarizes Clair's legal notices, privacy practices and policies. Use the links on the right to jump to specific documents and resources.
privacy.policy_text: We collect and process data to provide and improve our products and services. We are committed to protecting your personal information and being transparent about how it is used. For full details, consult the full policy linked to the right.
privacy.terms_text: These terms govern your access to and use of Clair products and websites. By using our services you agree to these terms. Please review them carefully.
privacy.cookies_text: We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the site works correctly and to personalize content. You can control cookie preferences in your browser.
privacy.data_text: Information about how we process personal data for product functionality, analytics and service delivery. Businesses can request data processing addenda where applicable.
privacy.security_text: We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal information. No system can be 100% secure, but we continuously work to improve our defenses.
privacy.contact_text: If you have legal or privacy questions, email privacy@clair.com or use the contact page to reach support.
